views.rationale: LIN reported sales up 30% and operating profit up 115% YoY, far exceeding JNJ's 6.7% sales growth
JPM disclosed revenue grew 12% YoY with net income up 58%, while GS provided only exposure tables with no growth metric
KO warned that new indirect taxes on sugary beverages could increase costs and reduce demand, whereas GOOGL expects continued benefit from the online advertising shift
PG net earnings rose 26% YoY (to $3.216B) while NEE net income grew about 15% YoY (from $1.88B to $2.171B)
UNH reported a $1.2B tax benefit from deferred tax liability revaluation, lowering its effective tax rate, whereas PFE only noted Brexit and trade risks without offsetting upside
